d: Own money, own name, no press access or comped balance. A figure is only labelled field-tested if it came from an account that could be frozen like anyone else's.
At least three sizes per operator, from the minimum to four figures, timed from confirmed request to first on-chain broadcast so network congestion is excluded.
Open each tracked title inside the operator's own client and read the stated return. It is the only way to catch a reduced build the lobby does not disclose.
Wagering, weighting, caps, expiry and max bet, copied from the operator's own page on the date of test, then flagged where they materially limit withdrawal.
One simple, one about a withdrawal, one deliberately ambiguous, across time zones. Record first reply and resolution.
A field-tested operator is due a re-test at least quarterly, and sooner if a reader reports a change we can reproduce. Its page carries the date of its last pass.
